items.title: Health and safety at work
items.source: Draft for review. Written by an AI assistant from general UK small-business knowledge, not from a cited document. Check every fact against current GOV.UK and regulator guidance, and have someone who does this work review it, before it is activated. Rules differ by country and change.
items.body: Employers have a legal duty to look after the health and safety of staff and others affected by their work. The core is the risk assessment: find what could cause harm, decide who might be harmed and how, decide what controls are needed, record the findings if you have five or more employees, and review them. Provide training, protective equipment where needed, first aid, and a safe place to work. Report serious accidents and diseases as the law requires. Involve staff: they often know the real dangers. Safety is not a one-off task; keep checking.
